wc-seed.name: WorshipCommons seed transcription
wc-seed.licenseBasis: Public-domain hymn texts (words and music published pre-1931) transcribed into ChordPro with inline chords for the original library — generated/imported during development, not taken from a single external source.

open-hymnal.name: Open Hymnal Project
open-hymnal.licenseBasis: Each ABC source's copyright line verified public domain at import time; only fully-PD scores taken. 2014.06 bulk zip plus live http://openhymnal.org/Abc/ files not in that zip (snapshot 2026-09-03). Dumont/Medcalf/Bird worship-only texts excluded.

cyber-hymnal.name: The Cyber Hymnal
cyber-hymnal.licenseBasis: Its copyright page treats un-noticed material as public domain (to the best of its knowledge) and posts newer material only with the copyright holder's permission, shown per page by a public-domain ("freely usable") marker; reposting is granted with attribution. Pages with copyright notices, or post-1930 credits without the marker, were excluded at import. Newer translations rest on that permission and are accepted only when the original they translate is public domain (rule 2026-09-17; evidence per song in sources/grants/cyber-hymnal-dedication.txt). Salvaged via the Wayback Machine.

hymnsite.name: HymnSite.com
hymnsite.licenseBasis: The site's FAQ (hymnsite.com/faq.htm) releases its umh### MIDI files with "NO RESTRICTIONS".

hymnary.name: Hymnary.org
hymnary.licenseBasis: Only texts hymnary.org marks "Copyright: Public Domain"; also the source of the hymnal-count popularity metadata.

worshipcommons.name: WorshipCommons (generated)
worshipcommons.licenseBasis: Produced by WorshipCommons tooling — cover art, and lyric timings derived from the public-domain tune sources.

wikimedia-commons.name: Wikimedia Commons
wikimedia-commons.licenseBasis: CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication MIDI settings of traditional / public-domain hymn melodies (Peter Gerloff / Rabanus Flavus).

cmaa.name: Church Music Association of America — English Hymns in the Commons
cmaa.licenseBasis: Newly composed English hymns the CMAA publishes under CC BY 3.0 on the linked page; each song.json carries the per-file licenseVersion and licenseUrl.

cmpilato.name: C. Michael Pilato — worship-music
cmpilato.licenseBasis: Repository README and each song README state CC BY 3.0 Unported or Public Domain per composition; imported per file with the README license line as the row license.

mutopia.name: Mutopia Project
mutopia.licenseBasis: Per-file SPDX on the Mutopia hymn listing. SATB hymntunes marked CC-PDDC (public-domain dedication of the typesetting) are attached as sheet PDFs to matching public-domain catalog songs. The Foundation SATB is CC BY-SA 2.0 and is a separate catalog row.

kevin-kwon.name: Kevin Kwon (Mr. Edification)
kevin-kwon.licenseBasis: Writer comments on each KhmerWorship song page dedicate the composition to the public domain and point at https://copy.church/free (the CC0-style legal text). Thank You For My Wife also says on the page 'This song is for the Public Domain'. Listed at https://freely.giving/music.

mark-feezell.name: Mark Feezell — DrFeezell.com
mark-feezell.licenseBasis: Per-work CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication on the composition page and on the score itself (Holy is the Lord 2024-04-10; Hallelujah No. 1 2024-03-16, also copy.church/free). Instrumental arrangements of already-catalogued hymns are not imported as new songs.

andrew-case.name: Andrew Case — His Magnificence
andrew-case.licenseBasis: Author confirmed 2026-09-14 that original songs at hismagnificence.com/music/ are dedicated to the public domain (CC0), superseding 2008 All Rights Reserved footers on lyric PDFs. Covers of other writers, ESV psalm sheets, and Sing Hebrew were not taken.

larry-holder.name: Larry Holder Music
larry-holder.licenseBasis: Copyright retained. The site's permissions page (larryholdermusic.org/copyright.html) grants non-profit copy, worship use, internal arrangements, and non-profit recordings, with original credits kept. Translation and lyric/melody changes are not granted. CCLI reporting is optional. Elton Smith co-writes are included under the same grant; other co-writers and novelty tracks were not taken.

songs-of-praise.name: Songs of Praise (Elton Smith)
songs-of-praise.licenseBasis: Translations of Larry Holder / Elton Smith songs hosted by Elton Smith. On 2026-09-16 Elton confirmed they are available under Larry Holder Music's non-profit permissions (larryholdermusic.org/copyright.html), translator credit kept. Only translations of songs already in the library under larry-holder are taken.

attribution.text: Larry Holder / Elton Smith, Songs of Praise
